jan_recommendation: Cold winter days and foggy mornings, pack warm layers and allow extra travel time.
feb_recommendation: Cool and pleasant late winter, great for monuments and gardens with a light jacket.
mar_recommendation: Warm and pleasant early summer weather, perfect for outdoor sightseeing!
apr_recommendation: Summer heat is rising, sightsee in the morning and stay hydrated through the day.
may_recommendation: Very hot summer with strong sun, avoid midday outings and drink plenty of water.
jun_recommendation: Extreme heat before the monsoon arrives, stay indoors at midday and keep hydrated.
jul_recommendation: Monsoon showers bring humid heat, carry an umbrella and plan some indoor activities.
aug_recommendation: The wettest month with heavy monsoon rain, expect waterlogging and keep an umbrella handy.
sep_recommendation: The monsoon is retreating with occasional showers, warm days suit indoor and evening plans.
oct_recommendation: Pleasant post monsoon weather with clear skies, perfect for outdoor sightseeing!
nov_recommendation: Cool and dry post monsoon days, carry a light jacket for evenings and check air quality.
dec_recommendation: Cool winter days and cold nights, pack warm clothes for evening outings.
